entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Hey, [fName]-kun. Might I[n]borrow you for a bit?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think we need to talk. Can you come[n]to the roof after school?
entries.uk: Гадаю, нам треба поговорити. Зможеш[n]прийти на дах після уроків?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm. You'll find out soon enough.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Whenever you're free... I'll be waiting.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh? Why are you apologizing?[n]I'm not angry or anything...
entries.uk: Га? Чому ти вибачаєшся?[n]Я зовсім не серджуся...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Perhaps I phrased it a bit ominously,[n]didn't I? No, I just want to talk to you.
entries.uk: Мабуть, це прозвучало трохи зловісно,[n]так? Ні, я просто хочу з тобою[n]поговорити.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Whenever you're free... I'll be waiting.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I know it's a bit sudden... My apologies.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, looks like the train's coming.[n]Let's line up.
entries.uk: О, здається, поїзд під'їжджає.[n]Станьмо в чергу.
